meta.title: Enrollment Process | HiFive English
meta.description: From a free level test to your first class — here's how to get started with HiFive English.

hero.paragraph: The level test, trial class, and consultation are all completely free. Signing up doesn't mean you have to pay right away — take your time, check everything out, and decide whenever you're ready.

levelTestCta: Sign Up for a Free Level Test

1.title: Free Sign-Up
1.desc: Create a free account first to apply for your level test. There's no cost involved at all.

2.title: Apply for a Level Test
2.desc: Just enter your preferred date and time, learning goals, and desired course to complete your application. Within 1-2 days, a learning manager will contact you directly to confirm your schedule and discuss the right class direction for you.
2.note: This isn't just about booking a test slot — from the very start, we work together to find the class direction that's right for you.

3.title: Free Level Test & Trial Class
3.desc: At your scheduled time, you'll have a combined level test and trial class with the same tutor you'd actually learn with. Think of it less as an exam and more as a chance to experience a real class and see if your level and the teaching style are the right fit.

4.title: Check Your Results
4.desc: Within a day of your level test, you can check your results on your My Page. It's not just a score — you'll also get guidance on your current level and what to focus on going forward.

5.title: Enrollment Consultation
5.desc: After reviewing your results, you'll consult with a learning manager to decide on the course that's right for you. There's no pressure to enroll at this stage — take your time and decide whenever you feel ready.

6.title: Tuition Payment
6.desc: Once your class time and course are finalized, tuition is paid before classes begin. As soon as payment is complete, your regular classes will start according to the confirmed schedule.

7.title: Check Your Schedule
7.desc: You can check your class days and times, assigned tutor, and course details on your My Page. Take a moment beforehand to check your class setup and get ready.

8.title: Regular Classes Begin
8.desc: Classes start at the scheduled date and time. For a smooth start, please log in and wait at least 5 minutes before class begins. Now the real learning starts — no more testing.

closing.heading: Start by finding out your English level.
closing.paragraph: Signing up for a free level test doesn't mean you need to pay right away. Try it out first, get all the information you need through a consultation, and decide whenever you're comfortable.
